Class UserManager

java.lang.Object
ry.ms.businessLogic.user.login.UserManager
public class UserManager extends Object
Manages user-related business logic, such as authentication. This class acts as a service layer between the presentation/facade layer and the data access layer.

  • Method Details

    • login

      public User login(String mail, String password) throws UserDoesntExistException, SQLException, IncorrectPasswordException
      Authenticates a user based on their email and password.
      Parameters:
      mail - The email of the user trying to log in.
      password - The password provided by the user.
      Returns:
      The User object if authentication is successful.
      Throws:
      UserDoesntExistException - if the user with the specified email does not exist.
      IncorrectPasswordException - if the provided password is not correct.
      SQLException - if a database access error occurs.
